ui.accompaniment.title: Singing-practice accompaniment suggestions
ui.accompaniment.hint: These editable suggestions do not reproduce the original arrangement. Select an interval, choose an alternative, or edit its root, quality and inversion. No accompaniment silences that interval. Auditioning never replaces the confirmed arrangement.
ui.accompaniment.stale_candidate: The melody structure changed. Close this stale candidate and generate again. Your confirmed arrangement and corrections are retained.
ui.accompaniment.stale_confirmed: Accompaniment is stale: corrections retained, playback disabled.

messages.storage.invalid_accompaniment_f: Invalid accompaniment fields: check enums, programs, velocities, integer tick intervals, pitch classes, inversions and overlaps.
messages.audio.invalid_accompaniment: The accompaniment playback plan is invalid.
messages.audio.invalid_practice_mix: The practice mix settings are invalid.

messages.accompaniment.measure_alignment: Some written measures do not match the meter. Check the chord intervals.
messages.accompaniment.pickup: Suggestions account for the pickup measure. Audition the pickup and following downbeat.
